title: Close all 14 ClayCode BASE work packages by one evidence-gated Ubuntu cascade
goal: Drive CC-WP-01 through CC-WP-14 to PASS only through executable production-chain evidence, minimizing semantic redesign and reusing current G9/D candidate evidence where it survives strict tests.
execution_law: test -> receipt -> learn -> repair lowest failing layer -> rerun -> next dependent gate; never skip a failed predecessor and never convert proxy/model agreement into PASS

CC-WP-02-PARSER-CANON: Strict-build research_entity/claycode/base/D_LALR_GRAMMAR_REPAIR_CANDIDATE_V4.lark with lark[interegular]==1.3.1 and require zero parser-table conflicts and zero regex collisions.
Parse full current CLAYCODE_G9_FUSION_SPEC_V3.clay plus DIALECT_REGISTRY_V3.clay and negative keyword/newline corpus.
Produce canonical typed-AST/semantic-hash equivalence receipts for preserved source meaning and reject lexical-identity loss.
CC-WP-01-SPEC-FREEZE: Freeze only the semantic subset that survives WP02 and current executable counterexamples; preserve unresolved provx/reader experimental status separately.
Hash frozen semantic spec, grammar, dialect registry and authority invariants.
CC-WP-03-IR-TYPES: Re-integrate typed function signatures/calls, records, unions/optional, Set/Ordered/Map, semantic_hash versus contract_hash, epochs and provenance identities.
Property-test canonical identity under set permutation/duplication and ordered-sequence mutation.
CC-WP-04-TYPE-EFFECT: Check compositional function signatures/effects and require model output != execution authority.
Fuzz capability forgery, revoke/regrant, stale epoch and invalid FFI/resource identities fail closed.
CC-WP-05-EVALUATOR: Run reference evaluator against frozen recurrence-decision and pure-computation fixtures; differential against independent oracle with zero unexplained mismatches.
CC-WP-06-COMPILER-LOWERING: Lower same fixtures through production ClayCode path to Ubuntu-native and/or WASM/WASI backend.
Record source/IR/backend hashes and differential semantic receipts.
CC-WP-07-RUNTIME-ABI-FFI: Implement typed Ubuntu ABI/FFI, module/package/resource identity and external capability/effect gateway; no ambient authority.
Run package-lock/provenance and resource-lifetime/TOCTOU discriminators already queued in RAE.
CC-WP-09-CONCURRENCY-MEMORY: Implement cancellation/error/retry, async tasks, atomics/resource lifetime and deterministic receipt identity sufficient for APP-04.
Stress with randomized schedules and stale-resource/replay cases.
CC-WP-08-STDLIB-SDK: Provide minimal files/process, HTTP, DB, async, GUI/event-loop and numerical/GPU host adapters on Ubuntu with typed capability boundaries.
CC-WP-10-GENERAL-APP-SUITE: Execute APP-01 CLI, APP-02 HTTP website, APP-03 DB service, APP-04 concurrent service, APP-05 GUI/interactive, APP-06 compiler/tool, APP-07 GPU/ML/numerical, APP-08 sandboxed system effect, APP-09 real FRANK component and APP-10 full FRANK handoff readiness.
No application counts as passed without actual Ubuntu execution receipt.
CC-WP-11-FUZZ-CONFORMANCE: Run unit/property/fuzz/mutation/roundtrip/conformance/differential suites across parser through runtime/FFI/apps; preserve every minimized counterexample.
CC-WP-12-CORPUS-HELDOUT: Generate semantics-derived positive/negative corpus from frozen compiler contracts and create leak-resistant held-out suite after compiler semantics stabilize.
CC-WP-13-HARNESS-HANDOFF: Compile at least one frozen real FRANK subsystem through production path, then prove H2/H3-required semantics have no escape hatch; reopen earliest failing ClayCode WP on counterexample.
CC-WP-14-BASE-AUDIT: Build CLAYCODE_GENERAL_PURPOSE_COMPILER_MANIFEST.json with exact hashes and all APP receipts.
Require all 14 WPs PASS, unresolved-language-counterexample ledger empty of P0/P1 blockers, GENERAL_PURPOSE_GATE PASS and target Ubuntu receipts before BASE PASS.

repair_policy: Fix the lowest layer that explains a failing executable counterexample. Prefer compiler/runtime/stdlib/FFI repair over ClayCode semantic change. Semantic change requires a minimized executable language counterexample plus supervisor review.
blocked_external_surfaces: Hosted ChatGPT is not connected to Andreas Ubuntu developer target
